name: Druid Natural Transmogrifist
body:
Natural transmogrifists tap into the power of summon nature’s ally to empower them with animalistic armor and characteristics.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A natural transmogrifist is not proficient with any armor or shields.

Transmogrify Armor (Su)

When a natural transmogrifist casts summon nature’s ally, he can use transmogrify armor.

This ability replaces natural bond, but the transmogrifist can gain a ranger’s animal companion beginning at 4th level in place of resist nature’s lure.

Natural Aspect (Su)

At 3rd level, while using transmogrify armor, a natural transmogrifist gains an aspect of the creature he summoned. This functions as the shifter’s aspect ability.

At 7th level, the natural transmogrifist also gains one of his summoned creature’s natural attacks while using transmogrify armor.
